## Recurrence Hotspots
- **Mid-scan client-state mutation** — 4 of the 12 error-handling actioned items concern UI state changing while a sidecar process is running (× button, addFolders entry point, drop handler, picker button). Different entry points, same class of bug surfaced across PR-2 cycles 4 and 6. **Suggestion:** when adding any "running" state to a client-side action, audit every code path that calls `reset()` or mutates session-affecting state — not just the most obvious one. Disable both the trigger AND guard the handler.
- **Trust-boundary validation at the periphery** — 7 PR-2 threads across data-integrity (GPS truthiness, duplicates naming, `loadSettings` no validation, fade-duration `0`-as-falsy) all trace to the same root cause: trusting whatever the boundary handed back. PR-1 had the parallel symptom (`"type": 42` accepted as event). **Suggestion:** when reading from any external source (localStorage, IPC, EXIF, user input), write the per-field type/range guard in the same commit as the read.
- **Gemini repeated re-raises** — temp-file collision raised 3 times across cycles 2/5/6, Windows path split raised 2 times across cycles 2/6. Both have stable, documented dismissals (file never written; macOS-only per PRD NFR6). **Suggestion:** future cycles can dismiss immediately if Gemini surfaces these again without new context.
